description: Move a running session to another computer mid-task (by needs, provider or compute_id). The old computer stops only after the new one is up.

needs.description: What the work needs. Any of: desktop (true for a screen/browser), gpu (true or a name like A100), gpu_memory_gb, ram_gb, cpu_cores, disk_gb, os (macos|linux), arch, tools (e.g. ["ffmpeg","docker"]), online.

name: move_session
